subject: kraken
pitch:
Category: Monster.
Subject: kraken rising, tentacles spread.
Style: Overwatch.
reasoning:
Looking at the renders, I notice the mantle reads as a blocky faceted cone rather than something organic, the body's low-poly sweep looks crude with flat shading, and the sigil decal feels too small against the overall silhouette.

I also catch that the near-camera tentacle's underside shows a brownish tone from the countershading, which clashes with the rest of the palette — I'm thinking of brightening that belly color to a more vivid coral-pink. On top of that, in the three-quarter view one of the front tentacles crosses over and occludes the face, which hides the maw and needs repositioning.

I want to spread the front arms wider by adjusting their azimuth and maybe enlarge the eyes slightly for more presence. The mast placement and sail lean are fine as is, and the gray ground marks are just rigging shadows, nothing to fix there — though the jaw does feel a bit loose and needs tightening.

The teeth ring is attached near the jaw but probably belongs to the head; it reads fine visually as a protruding cream spiky maw, so I'll leave sizing alone rather than enlarge it. The fins look a bit like flat floating ears sticking off the mantle — acceptable for now, though they could use more shape to feel less disconnected.

The dorsal spikes, tentacle suckers, and glowing nodules all look fine. The splash crowns at the base blend into the foam ring and are barely visible, and the body's lower portion shows a dark navy belly emerging from a flat water disc, which reads acceptably overall.

The silhouette feels a bit repetitive with symmetrical arms, so I want to add variety through tentacle thickness and bolder Overwatch-style shapes with strong rim colors. I'm thinking of brightening the mantle's lit top toward orchid, adding orchid spot bands and cream/coral fin stripes, plus a dorsal aqua chevron stripe for more visual interest.

Writing the chevron pattern logic...

I'm defining chevron stripe patterns based on angular distance from the dorsal line, then checking mantle surface smoothness and reconsidering the sigil decal placement — it's currently too small and tucked near the brow, so I want to enlarge and reposition it higher on the mantle front without overlapping the gold joint bands.

The band positions keep conflicting with the sigil, so I'll just leave the sigil placement as is rather than chase a perfect fix. Tentacle tips with curled hooks and glowing orbs look good, but I should thicken the arm base a bit for a heroic feel while keeping the webbing hidden. Ground interplay is fine as is, and I'm moving on to check how the eyes catch light given their protrusion.

The eyes sitting on cream-yellow spheres reads cute, and the jaw rig with teeth posed at a slight angle works well enough even if the teeth don't perfectly follow the upper jaw. The mantle-to-arm proportions seem acceptable, so I'll focus edits on spreading the front tentacles wider to clear the face and fixing the belly color — the arms are reading muddy brown instead of coral, likely from shadowed vertex lighting, so I should shift the belly tone toward a brighter pink mix to compensate.

I'm also planning to add chevron stripes to the mantle with brighter paint, thicken the tentacles, and slightly enlarge the eyes and decals while bumping the brow position up a bit. The mast placement near the front-left arm could use adjusting, but the teeth-ring bone attachment issue isn't worth chasing further, so I'll leave it and instead look at scaling up the fin outlines for more color and presence.

Now I'm figuring out placement of a glowing aqua halo ring near the water's edge beneath the kraken to add an Overwatch-style UI glow, calculating the right radius and height along the water profile curve so it sits just above the foam ring without colliding with the rune cards.

I'm now planning precise search-and-replace edits to the BODY_TOP paint function, adding a chevron pattern parameter and modifying its signature, making sure the replaced lines are unique so the edits apply correctly. Writing chevron shader code...

I also want to adjust arm thickness values, update the DEFS array entries for FR/FL azimuth angles, and tweak the eye geometry code accordingly.
